events.label: NVIDIA (NVDA) Q2 FY27 earnings, after market close
events.notes: Largest single-name catalyst for NQ this week given NVDA's index weight. Consensus ~$91-92B revenue vs NVIDIA's own $91.0B +/-2% guidance. Historically moves NQ 5-10%+ on the print. Call starts ~5:00pm ET same day.

events.label: Core PCE Price Index (Jul) -- Fed's preferred inflation gauge
events.notes: SOURCE CONFLICT, FLAGGED NOT RESOLVED: one source has this Wed 8/26, another has it Thu 8/27, both citing 8:30am ET. Verify closer to release rather than trusting this date blindly. Consensus ~0.2% MoM, ~3.2% YoY.

events.label: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium begins (through Aug 29)
events.notes: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh speaks during the symposium -- historically the marquee keynote lands Friday morning, but exact slot not yet confirmed as of this write. Same macro driver behind the current gold rally (fiscal sustainability / bond buyback concerns); a hawkish surprise pressures gold, a dovish one extends the rally.

events.label: Initial Jobless Claims (weekly)
events.notes: Standard weekly cadence, Thursdays 8:30am ET. Only market-moving on a meaningful surprise vs. the 4-week average.

events.label: Non-Farm Payrolls Annual Revision (preliminary)
events.notes: Data-quality/revision release, not the regular monthly NFP report -- can still move markets on a large revision surprise.
